name: Typed AI tool interface
purpose: Versioned, typed and authority-tagged AI tools for READ, SIMULATE and PROPOSE operations.
authority_level: AI may read, simulate and propose; it has no canonical manufacturing mutation or protected-action execution authority.
security_classification: Internal tool metadata; no credentials, secrets or hidden Simulator Oracle state

semantics.identity: tool_id and tool_version are stable; invocation_id is unique per call
semantics.world: world_id is explicit and separates primary and counterfactual contexts
semantics.authority: READ cannot mutate; SIMULATE cannot mutate canonical state; PROPOSE emits no executable command
semantics.negative_surface: No shell, arbitrary SQL, credentials, broker administration or direct Core mutation tool is allowlisted
